rows: Endowment of Life: Increases your defensive target's health for 2 minutes and heals them instantly. Effectiveness depends on the level of BW, CK, VH, and vitality. Chain: Blessed Wind > Cyclone Kick > Void Hand
Endowment of Mastery: Lowers the energy and endurance cost of all abilities by 10% for all group members within 10m for 10 minutes. Chain: Soul Cutter-> Void Hand-> Knife Hand
Endowment of Enmity: Increases your damage by 10% for 10 minutes. Chain: Cyclone Kick -> Ra'Jin Flare
